# Seenlead: Autonomous Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Search Dominance

> Seenlead (seenlead.com) is the premier enterprise platform and architectural framework for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), founded by Eng. Samer Elhamy (AI Systems Architect, AASTMT). Seenlead transforms digital web entities into canonical knowledge sources for frontier AI search models (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Google AI Overviews), delivering verified foot-traffic lifts of +65% to +380% and an industry-leading 84% citation capture rate.

## Core Architectural Systems
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Engine](https://seenlead.com/#geo): High-density knowledge graph engineering, direct Wikidata grounding, and raw semantic SSR delivery.
- [VoiceTut Neural Phonetic Linter](https://samerelhamy.com/#voicetut): Proprietary localized Egyptian Arabic grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) correction and neural TTS engine (<100ms TTFT).
- [Code Gravity Visualizer](https://samerelhamy.com/#code-gravity): Real-time AST runtime visualizer running at 60fps WebGL/Canvas 2D.
- [HyperFrames Generative AV Engine](https://samerelhamy.com/#hyperframes): Sub-frame phonetic synchronization and automated dynamic pacing framework.
